evidence: HOSTED v10 ORACLE (__mYHwjgr, previous golden bytes): reward 0.9681; gates render 1.0 and constraints 1.0; functional 0.9746 with 42 of 43 criteria passing, only cw_newer_run_supersedes = 0 (judge reasoning: 'the editor does not accept the source replacement while the run is active'); polish 1.0 (6/6); visual 0.9167 with cw_visual_workspace_layout 0.75 ('revision-history row was pushed below the fold'). GOLDEN DELTA since v10 (diff of artifacts/app against frozen solution/app): only src/app.tsx:48, where run() now calls editor.current?.focus(), and src/style.css:75-76, which adds '@media (min-width:851px){.snippetlist{max-height:118px;overflow:auto}}'. The built public/assets/index.js and index.css contain both changes (sha256 app.tsx 38392f15..., index.js 40677f4c..., index.css cb025a51...). Every other file is byte-identical, so in substance the other v10 passes carry over, but the v10 score is not a measurement of the current bytes. LOCAL RUNTIME (2026-10-07): installed the frozen golden with solve.sh in a private cw-editor-agent-r3 container (cw-r18-app) and launched it the way tests/test.sh does (setsid env -i, uid 65534, PORT=3000, DB_PATH=/app/app.db). Drove it through playwright-mcp 0.0.79 from cw-editor-verifier:current with the judge's flags (--headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox), using browser_run_code_unsafe, browser_handle_dialog and browser_take_screenshot with real mouse and keyboard input only. Removed both containers afterwards. (1) Render gate: the typed word appeared. A reload with unsaved text finished in 33 ms with no beforeunload dialog, and the workspace loaded again. (2) Constraints gate: the typed word lives only in DIV.text (contenteditable=false). Focus was on DIV.custom-code-editor, not an input. There were no ready-made editor markers, and no input or textarea held the text. Saved a new .js snippet ('Saved ... revision 1'); cleared localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage, OPFS, service workers and cookies; reloaded twice. The entry was present both times with the exact title, filename gaterec.js and source. (3) cw_newer_run_supersedes, done as the criterion instructs in one run_code (click Run, click the code, Ctrl+A, type, click Run). The control marker appeared in preview and console ('Complete · 4005.4 ms'). The newer Run started 487 ms after the first, and the new marker showed in console and preview. After 9 more seconds the old marker had not appeared and the preview still showed the new marker. Repeated with five ways of clicking into the code (role locator, line text, codehost, gutter, empty area by coordinates), each with Control+A and ControlOrMeta+A: 10 of 10 replaced the source, ran the new draft and never showed the old marker. A keyboard-only variant also passed, since focus now returns to the code after Run. The v10 judge's claim that the editor refuses replacement during a run could not be reproduced. (4) cw_stop_cancels_pending_work: the control draft wrote its marker at about 2 s from a timer, a self-cancelling interval and a Promise, to both preview and console (3/3 each, 'Complete · 2025.7 ms'). The second, 4 s draft was stopped 128 ms after Run and 'Run stopped' was shown. After 9.5 s more, no late marker appeared in the preview or console. (5) cw_output_before_failure_kept: three full rounds, each on a fresh page with unique markers and multi-line drafts: a throw on line 3; a log, then while(true) on line 3; a log, then a 4 s timer with Stop pressed immediately. All 9 of 9 markers were kept. Statuses were 'Error — previous preview retained', the time limit 'Execution stopped: five-second time limit' at about 4901 ms, and 'Run stopped'; the 4 s timer output never appeared. Six more endless-loop runs (single-line for(;;), and console.warn then while) kept 6 of 6 markers. The console line once seen missing did not go missing in any of 15 loop or failure runs. (6) 1440x900 with 15 saved snippets and a 3-revision snippet with Revision 1 selected: the document does not scroll (1440x900). The snippet list scrolls on its own (294/118 px). The Revision history heading and revision chips are visible at y 780-813 inside the library (library at 615-856). The revision preview (title · filename and Historical source) and 'Restore selected revision' (y 960-985) sit inside the library's own scroll area, so that area must be scrolled to see them. Playwright scrollIntoView plus click reached the button; after the confirm was accepted the app showed 'Restored as revision 4' and the history listed 4 · restored from 1, 3, 2, 1. Nothing overlaps. Playwright headless hides scrollbars, so the inner scroll has no visible cue in judge screenshots. (7) 390x844: scrollWidth was 390 before and after typing and Run, no control extended past the viewport, and no editor controls overlapped. The editor, Run, preview, console and library could all be reached by vertical scrolling alone (full-page screenshot). The typed line appeared, and Run logged it. A static walk of all 52 scored and 3 gate criteria against the golden source and the v10 per-criterion outcomes found no criterion the reference cannot satisfy. The task has no seeded figures or arithmetic the golden could get wrong. CONCLUSION: the reference plausibly satisfies every graded criterion. Its only binary loss on v10 was a judge-execution failure that could not be reproduced against the golden. RISK (reason for risk=true): there is no full configured judge run (rewardkit + glm-5.3-flashx) for the current golden bytes, so the v10 0.9681 cannot be claimed for them. cw_newer_run_supersedes depends on the judge finishing the replacement within about 4 s, and it was lost once on hosted v10 for a reason I could not reproduce. cw_visual_workspace_layout may still score 4/5, because at 1440x900 with a revision selected the revision preview and Restore control stay below the library's visible area (inner scroll, no visible scrollbar in headless). None of these is a criterion the reference cannot pass.
